limitations: Role-based SQL tests simulate request claims; they do not verify user JWT signatures, real login or actual global logout.
Storage SQL checks cover metadata/policies, not actual uploaded bytes.
Both rollback suites use sequential single-connection execution; live concurrent-worker races remain unverified.
Merchant account, isolated test environment/credits, price selection, callback/origin configuration and provider testing remain pending.
